messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: `GPU_POOL_MEM_PRESSURE` for pool=triton-west2a count=18 severity=high. Top symptom: repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` on infer pods. Auto-suppress window=60s

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-8342 created and routed to `eng-oncall` (urgency: high). Notification bundle: 3 active pages.

sophia-oncall: acked INC-8342 :point_up: I'm on it, pulling traces.

jamal: On call, joining. quick check — are these from a single model or multi-tenant?

sophia-oncall: looks multi-tenant. early logs show kvcache evictions skyrocketing then cuda alloc fail. grabbing `nvidia-smi` output from node-tn-06: 
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 525.85.12    Driver Version: 525.85.12    CUDA Version: 11.8     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0    A100-SXM4-80GB  On        | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                    0 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
|        ID   ID                                                 Usage      |
|  0      -    -      12458      C   triton_server                     75680MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

liam: node looks saturated. Any recent deploys to that pool?

sophia-oncall: no deploys in last 12h. autoscaler did scale up pods but GPUs remained full.

jamal: mitigating step: temporarily enable pool-level throttling to reduce concurrent inferences. Can we lower max_concurrency on triton config for pool triton-west2a?

liam: done — pushed config change: `max_concurrency: 8 -> 4` to pool triton-west2a. Rolling restart of triton-runtime on affected nodes (non-disruptive intent).

incident-bot: Applied throttling policy. Restart jobs started: triton-runtime/rollout/tn-06, tn-07, tn-08.

ops-ana: Customer impact check: /metrics shows 5 customers with increased error rate (5xx) over the last 3m, but tail latency for others stable. Noting customer A (id: cust-1221) reported increased 503s.

jamal: opened a ticket to support for cust-1221, adding a note about transient GPU mem pressure and mitigation (throttle).

sophia-oncall: after throttling and restarts, cuda alloc errors dropped to ~2/min from 40/min. KV cache evictions decreased. Monitoring for 15m window.

liam: also temporarily disabled aggressive prefetch in model optimizer on that pool (`prefetch_enabled: true -> false`) to reduce memory churn.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert update: INC-8342 acknowledged by sophia-oncall and jamal. Escalation paused.

ops-ana: Running quick sanity: `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep triton` shows mem stable. Logs show fewer `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation`.

jamal: planning handoff at +30m if stable. Sophia — can you prepare notes for postmortem (timeline, root triggers, mitigation timeline)?

sophia-oncall: will draft. Early hypothesis: sudden workload spike with large sequence lengths + aggressive prefetch caused kvcache churn -> memory fragmentation -> cuda alloc failures. Need to add more observability around sequence length distribution per model.

liam: action items captured: 1) add sequence-length histograms to metrics (AP-2457), 2) consider KV cache defragmentation window (INF-3321), 3) review default prefetch thresholds.

ops-ana: Support notified customers and will track recovery. I'll update incident channel when all affected customers show <1% error-increase for 20m.

sophia-oncall: marking for follow-up. Leaving monitoring in place. If errors climb again, escalate to infra-sre.

incident-bot: Incident INC-8342 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Auto-close timer started (60m).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: incident will remain on the timeline until manually closed or auto-close triggers.

liam: thanks team. Short postmortem sync in product meeting tomorrow at 10:30 to discuss workload shaping.

ops-ana: closing loop here, will ping when customers clear. :white_check_mark:
